jd_text: P&G Thailand is hiring for Account Manager, Customer Business Development in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
